summary: Mobile preview loads and the main Spanish tabs, roster creation, validation, match configuration, and attendance flow were exercised. The end-to-end match flow reached team assignment and scoring, but stats increment verification was blocked by missing test IDs and exposed a likely store bug in setStat.

integration_issues.flow: Partido de la Semana -> Goles y asistencias
integration_issues.issue: Stat controls have no testID and are below the fold on mobile; the attempted targeted increment could not be reliably selected. Code review indicates setStat uses current.stats[id]?.goals ?? 0 + delta (and equivalent assists), so an initial zero value is returned by ?? and the increment is ignored.

issues: The stats area is not initially visible in a 375x667 viewport, requiring scrolling; this is acceptable for a long screen but controls need robust IDs for verification.

react_native_issues.issue: Team assignment, score, stat, MVP, position, delete, and reset Pressables lack testID attributes, making mobile regression testing fragile compared with Convocatoria/Admin form inputs.

action_items: Fix setStat arithmetic by parenthesizing (current.stats[id]?.goals ?? 0) + delta and the assists equivalent.
Add stable testID values to match assignment, score +/- , stat +/- , MVP selector/options, position chips, and reset controls.
Retest full finalization and standings assertions for goals, assists, MVP, PJ, and points after the store fix.
critical_code_review_comments: setStat in frontend/src/store.tsx has nullish-coalescing precedence that prevents increments when a stat record already exists with zero.
No backend/API is used by this app; no API failures were applicable.
Expo logs show a React Native DevTools electron sandbox warning, but Metro bundled and the preview rendered successfully.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary local roster data during browser testing; no backend seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is https://torneo-verde.preview.emergentagent.com. Convocatoria, Admin navigation, empty validation, player add, match config, and attendance passed. End-to-end state was reset between browser contexts; rerun with stable testIDs after fixing setStat.
rca_of_issue: The stat updater expression uses optional chaining followed by ?? without parentheses: current.stats[id]?.goals ?? 0 + delta. Once a stats object exists, its zero value is selected and delta is never applied. Parenthesize the fallback before addition.
